Hi Jaime / procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Attached are the updated quote (v3) and the draft SOW for the private on-prem deployment we discussed. Two items where we need explicit executive approval from our side before we can finalize:

1) Audit access: Stratus has asked for a timeboxed audit window that includes the option for up to two short onsite or remote audits per year (up to 3 business days each) with access to logs and system artifacts.
2) Network/egress constraint: they require a locked egress policy that prevents outbound model telemetry outside their VPC, plus KMS/HSM integration for key material.

They've asked for a one-year committed term and are requesting a 10% one-time onboarding credit (applied against first invoice) to offset their integration costs.

Can you confirm whether the audit window + egress carveout and the requested onboarding credit are within deal desk guardrails, or if we need an exec signoff? I’ve cc'd Marissa from Deal Desk.

Next steps: if we can get quick guidance today I’ll turn the SOW into a final order form and send for signature.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben — thanks for the docs. A couple quick clarifying items from our side before you finalize:

- The audit scope: we need read-only access to system logs, KV cache traces (redacted if necessary), and the ability to run a short set of verification queries. We do not need access to customer PII.
- Onsite vs remote: preference for remote first; onsite only if remote cannot validate a specific control.
- Egress: we need strict assurance telemetry will not leave our VPC and will be routed to our logging endpoints.
- Pricing: the 10% onboarding credit is non-negotiable internally. It helps fund our integration engineering team.

Please escalate if any of the above lines up as a policy exception. Also confirm what the operational SLAs will be for patching windows and maintenance notifications.

Regards,

Ben / team — reviewed. Proposed Deal Desk position below (accepts the commercial ask with narrow exceptions):

Commercial proposal:
- Term: 12-month firm commitment.
- Onboarding credit: 10% one-time credit applied to first invoice (approved).
- Pricing impacts: credit absorbs across committed ARR; no change to list pricing beyond credit.

Technical/legal guardrails (must be included in SOW/legal addendum):
- Audit access: approve up to 2 remote audits per year, up to 3 business days each, read-only. Any request for raw PII or unrestricted KV data is disallowed — we will provide redacted KV extracts and a joint validation checklist for queries.
- Onsite visits: permitted only if remote validation cannot reasonably complete the audit; any onsite activity requires 15 business day notice and an agreed ops playbook.
- Egress: we can support route-to-VPC endpoints. A network-level egress lock will be configured; exceptions require SOC/infra approval.
- KMS/HSM: approved for integration; we require customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) and documented key rotation procedures.
- Ops SLAs: 48-hour security patch notifications; emergency patch SLO 72 hours for critical CVEs on deployed control plane components.

Legal flags (Kimberly): please confirm the redaction language below — we should clearly state what artifacts we will and will not provide. Also include an indemnity carveout for customer-controlled encryption keys.

Request: Laura — because this touches an exception to our standard on-prem audit access and a one-time credit, please provide exec signoff or escalate to commercial leadership.

If signoff comes back today I’ll update the order form and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

Marissa / team — I reviewed Marissa's proposed guardrails and approve the commercial concession (10% onboarding credit) and the limited audit access under the stated controls. Conditions for my signoff:

1) Audit scope must be explicitly limited in the SOW to read-only system logs, redacted KV outputs, and a defined verification checklist. No direct access to customer PII or plaintext customer data.
2) Onsite access is allowed only after remote attempts fail and requires 15 business days notice; security/infra must accompany any onsite activity.
3) KMS: customer-managed keys only. Redwood will not hold key material or plaintext customer secrets.
4) Egress: network policy must be enforced; infra to provide verification steps to Stratus and include a short attestation in the order form.
5) The 10% credit is a one-time onboarding credit, tied to activation. No recurring discount.

I want a short ops playbook included in the SOW that describes maintenance windows, patch cadence, and emergency contact flows. Karthik, coordinate to reflect the credit in the pricing worksheet and lock the commit term at 12 months. Kimberly, include the redaction language and indemnity carveout in the addendum.

Once Marissa confirms SOW wording, Ben can proceed to send the updated order form for signature and route through DocuSign. Approving now so we don’t lose momentum.

Laura Bennett

Subject: Final terms and order form (Stratus Health) — onboarding credit approved

Jaime — thanks for the quick responses. Per internal review we’re able to proceed under the following confirmed terms (approved by our commercial exec):

- Term: 12 months firm commitment.
- Onboarding credit: 10% one-time credit applied to the first invoice, contingent on activation.
- Audit: up to 2 remote audits per year, up to 3 business days each; read-only access to system logs and redacted KV extracts; joint verification checklist required. Onsite only if remote validation fails; 15 business days notice and infra/security presence required.
- Egress: telemetry and operational telemetry will be routed only to customer-designated VPC endpoints; infra will provide a verification attestation.
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys only; Redwood will not retain key material.
- Ops: 48-hour patch notification; emergency patch SLO 72 hours for critical vulnerabilities.

Attached are the updated order form (order_form_stratus_v2.pdf) and the revised SOW with the ops playbook inserted. Please review; I’ll send the DocuSign envelope once you confirm the acceptance language.
